policy: Official/guideline sources first. Screening never equals diagnosis. Claims about diagnostic process, differentials or rating scales must trace to an appropriate guideline or public-health source. Local adaptation must not change the underlying evidence claim.

rules: minimum three topic-appropriate sources per publishable page
no online questionnaire is presented as a diagnosis
assessment content separates screening, comprehensive assessment, differential diagnosis and support planning
adult and child pathways are not collapsed into one generic pathway
country-specific service pathways are labeled as such rather than universalized
